events.description: Called with a closable tab's id when its close mark is pressed, or Delete is pressed on it on web.
events.name: onClose

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The items, in order. The collection never sorts or filters them: the query that fetched them did.
props.name: items

props.description: The emphasis of the selected tab: `primary` is a raised pill, `secondary` a flat one. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: True to show every tab but refuse selecting any of them.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: The spoken name of the tab list, for example "Order sections"; name it when a page holds more than one.
props.name: label

props.description: True while items load: the collection is busy, and shows its loading state in place of the empty one.
props.name: isLoading

props.description:
What happens to tabs that do not fit the row: `scroll` (the default) scrolls the row; `menu` keeps the tabs that
fit and lists the rest in a "More" menu at the end (the selected tab always stays in the row). Native always scrolls.
props.name: overflow

props.description: The spoken name of what loads, for example "Loading orders"; it is read only while `isLoading` is true.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: What the collection shows when `items` is empty and nothing is loading, usually an `EmptyState`.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: The axis the tabs run along. Defaults to `horizontal`; native has no vertical tabs and reads it as horizontal.
props.name: orientation

props.description:
Animation configuration for tabs
- `"disable-all"`: Disable all animations including children (cascades down to all child components)
- `undefined`: Use default animations
props.name: animation

props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element
props.name: className

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
